era_note: Connellsville, Fayette County, Pennsylvania, 2001-2016. R3: a real unsolved killing and living people. shorts.angle: The first statement against her carried a detail the laboratory had disproved twenty months earlier. It was checkable in an afternoon, and the case went on.
shorts.avoids: Does not name the witness and does not say or imply that he, or anyone else, killed Curtis Haith. Does not depict the killing, the victim, or the scene. Reports only that the detail was wrong, which the record establishes.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: The one checkable detail was already ruled out. Why did that not stop it?
shorts.loop_join: The last line hands the case a direction, which is where the first line's twenty months of nothing ends.

lines.text: Twenty months went by with nothing.
source_lines: Twenty months went by like that.

lines.text: Then a man walked into a police station in Pennsylvania.
source_lines: In October of two thousand and two, a man named Thomas Beal went to the police.

lines.text: He said she had told him the blood on her clothes was the dead man's.
source_lines: According to Beal, Weimer had told him something specific. She had told him that the blood on her clothes was Haith's.

lines.text: The laboratory had established twenty months earlier that it was her boyfriend's.
source_lines: The DNA had already established, twenty months earlier, that the blood on her clothes was Gibson's.

lines.text: So the first statement against her contained a fact the evidence had already ruled out.
source_lines: So the first statement against her contained a fact that the evidence had already ruled out.

lines.text: There is a test available at that moment, and it costs nothing. Check it.
source_lines: There is a straightforward test available at that moment, and it costs nothing. A witness reports a confession. The confession contains a checkable detail. Check it.

lines.text: The detail was wrong. He was not set aside.
source_lines: The detail was wrong. Beal was not set aside.

lines.text: The investigation now had a direction.
source_lines: The detail was wrong. Beal was not set aside. The investigation now had a direction, and the direction was a woman whose physical evidence had cleared her twenty months earlier.

shorts.angle: The witness took it back under oath and the charges were dismissed. She was home for six months. Then a man in prison offered to implicate her for a lighter sentence, and she was arrested again.
shorts.avoids: Does not name the witness or the prisoner, and does not say or imply that either of them killed anybody. Does not depict the killing, the victim, or any real person. Does not characterise the prosecutor's intent; the record establishes the sequence, not the motive.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: A witness took it back on the stand and a judge sent her home. What brought her back?
shorts.loop_join: The last line returns to the courtroom of the first, with the case standing exactly where the witness had left it.

lines.text: At the hearing the Commonwealth called its witness to the stand.
source_lines: At that hearing, the Commonwealth called Thomas Beal to the stand as a witness of fact.

lines.text: Under oath, he took it all back.
source_lines: Under oath, Beal took it all back.

lines.text: He testified that an officer had, in his words, coaxed him along on how to do it.
source_lines: He testified that an officer had - his words - "kind of like coaxed me along on how to do it."

lines.text: The judge dismissed the charges. She went home.
source_lines: The judge dismissed the charges. Crystal Weimer went home.

lines.text: She was home for six months.
source_lines: She was home for six months.

lines.text: Then a man in prison offered to implicate her, in exchange for a lighter sentence on convictions of his own.
source_lines: He told police he would implicate Weimer in the murder. In exchange, he wanted a lighter sentence on convictions of his own, in an unrelated matter.

lines.text: On the strength of that statement, she was arrested a second time.
source_lines: On the strength of that statement, officers arrested Crystal Weimer for a second time and charged her again.

lines.text: Nothing new had been found.
source_lines: Nothing new had been found. Nothing new had been tested.
